notes: Source: 南方电网 95598 information API (areaCode 040000), monthly PDFs (text) 2025-11..2026-10.

NO tou_rule stored: every notice only says '峰谷分时电价按自治区发展改革委现行有关规定执行'. The last verifiable official text is 桂发改价格〔2023〕609号 (峰 11-13、17-23; 平 7-11、13-17; 谷 23-7), but a Nov-2024 consultation draft (峰 16-24; 平 0-1、7-12、14-16; 谷 1-7、12-14; 35 kV+ at once, others from 2025-03-01) was apparently finalised and its official text could not be retrieved (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn unreachable / not archived), so periods in force during 2025-11..2026-10 are unverified.
Printed TOU prices: 峰/谷 = 平 ± 50% × 当月平均上网电价 (信息表 item 5); 输配、线损、系统运行费、基金不浮动.

3rd-period tables (to 2026-07) print an extra component '其他' (其他折价 = 峰谷分时电价损益分摊) that the schema has no field for; it is not stored, so Σ components ≠ 电量电价 by that amount (components_sum failures for 2025-11 +0.00841, 2025-12 +0.00561, 2026-02 +0.001501; smaller values in other months are within tolerance). See announcements.json other_component_not_stored.
